description:
Here's a description of the line plot, following the guidelines:

The plot illustrates the relationship between the evaluated perplexity and the ratio of activated parameters. The x-axis is labeled "Activated Parameters Ratio (%)" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 100, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled "Eval PPL" and has a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick labels at intervals of 0.5. A dashed orange line, labeled "Transformer FFN", begins at approximately (0, 12.1) and increases to approximately (100, 13.7). A solid gray line, labeled "Only MoHD ATTN", starts at approximately (0, 12.2) and increases to approximately (100, 13.1). A solid blue line, labeled "Only MoHD ATTN + MLP", begins at approximately (0, 11.9) and increases to approximately (100, 12.9). A solid blue line with 'x' markers, labeled "MoHD ATTN", starts at approximately (0, 11.8) and increases to approximately (100, 13.4).
